items.title: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP
items.summary:

items.title: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
items.summary:
On 21 October 2026, GitLab published a security advisory addressing several vulnerabilities among which a critical flaw that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on a GitLab server. 
CERT-EU recommends organisations to update affected assets as soon as possible, prioritising internet facing assets, and to run an assessment to identify compromised assets.

items.summary:

items.summary:

items.title: Critical Vulnerability in Multiple Atlassian Products
items.summary:

items.summary:

items.title: Critical Vulnerability in F5 BIG-IP APM
items.summary:
On 22 September 2026, F5 published an advisory addressing a critical vulnerability affecting its BIG-IP APM product. The vendor confirmed active exploitation in the wild. 
CERT-EU recommends taking appropriate actions as soon as possible.

items.title: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
items.summary:
On 19 August 2026, Citrix published a security advisory addressing multiple critical vulnerabilities in NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway). 
CERT-EU recommends updating affected devices as soon as possible.
